title: The Signal
style: a cinematic night drama shot on 35 mm film: cool teal moonlight, warm amber practical lamps, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain

subjects.description: the radio astronomer from {picture}, a woman in her sixties with short grey hair, round glasses and a moss-green wool cardigan
subjects.retain: face, hair, glasses and cardigan are retained

subjects.description: the hilltop glass observatory from {picture}, with its brass radio receiver and domed glass roof
subjects.retain: architecture, brass receiver and glass dome are retained

shots.keyframe: Wide, locked-off exterior: <Subject 2> glows on a dark hilltop under a starry sky, rain clouds gathering.
shots.action: the camera slowly pushes in toward the glowing dome as wind bends the grass and the first raindrops streak the glass.
shots.soundscape: Wind across the hilltop, distant thunder, the first raindrops on glass.

shots.keyframe: Medium shot inside <Subject 2>: <Subject 1> sits at the brass receiver, headphones around her neck, lit by an amber lamp.
shots.action: <Subject 1> lifts the headphones to her ears and slowly turns the large tuning dial, listening intently while rain runs down the dome behind her.
shots.soundscape: Rain on the glass roof, the creak of the dial, soft radio static.

shots.keyframe: Extreme close-up of the receiver's glowing frequency needle resting between two numbers.
shots.action: the needle trembles, then swings sharply as the static resolves into a faint, regular pulse; a small green indicator lamp flickers on.
shots.soundscape: Static that resolves into a slow electronic pulse, a click as the lamp turns on.

shots.keyframe: Close-up of <Subject 1>'s face in amber light, eyes wide behind her round glasses.
shots.action: <Subject 1> holds her breath, then leans toward the microphone and speaks quietly, her voice trembling.
shots.soundscape: The faint pulse in her headphones, rain, her breathing.

dialogue.text: If you can hear me, answer on this frequency.

shots.keyframe: Wide shot inside <Subject 2>: <Subject 1> stands beside the receiver looking up through the dome at a single bright star.
shots.action: the bright star pulses in rhythm with the signal while <Subject 1> rises from her chair and walks slowly toward the glass, the camera tilting up with her gaze.
shots.soundscape: The pulse grows louder and steadier, rain softening.

shots.keyframe: Exterior wide shot: <Subject 2> on the hilltop at dawn, the storm clearing, a pale light on the horizon.
shots.action: the sky brightens as the clouds part; inside the dome a small amber lamp still glows, and the pulse fades to silence.
shots.soundscape: Birdsong at first light, dripping water, the pulse fading away.
